capabilities: watch configured metadata fields for changes
replace note headers with metadata values
execute Obsidian commands when metadata changes
configure header and command groups in settings
extras: Installation is manual via GitHub releases rather than a plugin store listing; repository name is metadata-watcher while the plugin id is watched-metadata.
problem: Obsidian's properties view only edits metadata; nothing reacts to metadata changes by updating note content or running commands automatically.
summary: Metadata watcher that monitors changes to note metadata fields and runs user-configured actions like header replacement or command execution.
